sources_quoted.source: data/items.json → item 3071 Black Cleaver, passives[0] (name "Carve"), branches[0]
sources_quoted.quote: Dealing {{as|physical damage}} to an enemy champion applies a stack of ''Carve'' for 6 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. Each stack inflicts {{as|6% armor reduction}}, up to {{as|30%|armor}} at 5 stacks.
Carve: Dealing physical damage to champions reduces the target's Armor by 6% for 6 seconds. (stacks 5 times).

sources_quoted.source: data/wiki-atoms/damage.json → atom damage.penetration ("Penetration and resistance reduction")
sources_quoted.quote: Effects that reduce the target's effective resistances before mitigation: percent penetration applies before flat penetration, results cannot go below 0, and only resistance reduction effects can drive armor/MR negative.
Armor and magic resistance reduce incoming physical/magic damage by a percentage (actual = raw x 100/(100 + resistance)); negative resistances amplify damage.
reduce_resistance(R, r_flat, r_pct):   R ← R − r_flat;  R ← R·(1 − r_pct/100)   [flat first, then %]  … R_final = max(0, (R − r_flat)·(1 − r_pct/100)·(1 − p) − f)

the established model uses a fixed `0.8·max_stacks` constant (with a `hits/2` short-fight branch) … the constant model equals the exact mean at ~10 autos and deviates by up to ±20% at the extremes … this is a documented tuning constant, not a theorem.

After using an ability, your next basic attack within 10 seconds deals {{as|100% '''base''' AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} [[on-hit]]. If the target is a champion, inflict them with ''Expose Weakness'' for 4 seconds, causing them to take {{rd|8%|5%}} increased damage from all sources

step_1_carve_magnitude.rule: Carve = 6% armor reduction per stack, max 5 stacks = 30% (cached wiki text + riotDescription for item 3071).
step_1_carve_magnitude.check_of_old_fraction: 0.12 = 2 stacks x 6% — an exactly representable Carve state (2 of 5 stacks). It is also what the engine's documented short-fight branch (`hits/2`) yields at 4 physical-damage instances; the constant model (0.8 x max_stacks = 4 stacks = 0.24) is the long-fight value. Per §2.3 the BC stack average is explicitly an APPROX tuning constant with ±20% documented spread at the extremes, so a value in the 0.09–0.30 band is inside the documented modelling class, not a formula error.

step_2_factor_consistency.formula: amplification from a p-fraction armor reduction against target armor A: f = m(A(1-p)) / m(A) = (100 + A) / (100 + (1-p)A), from m(R)=100/(100+R) (§2.1) and reduce_resistance's multiplicative % step (§2.2)
step_2_factor_consistency.conclusion: factor 1.07 pairs with fraction 0.12 for target armor A in ~[104, 139] — an ordinary level-18 armor value. The old entry's two numbers are mutually consistent under the repo's own resistance identity; nothing in the pair is arithmetically wrong.
step_2_factor_consistency.counterfactual: at max stacks (p=0.30) the same armor band would give f ~ 1.18-1.21, and at the 0.8*max_stacks constant (p=0.24) f ~ 1.15 — i.e. 1.07 is the partial-stack, not the saturated, reading.

step_3_scope_of_the_debuff_the_decisive_.claim: Carve is a debuff on the TARGET's armor, not an attacker-side penetration. The cached text says it 'reduces the target's Armor'; the atom taxonomy files it under damage.penetration/resistance reduction as an effect that 'reduce[s] the target's effective resistances before mitigation'; and §2.2 applies reduce_resistance to R (the defender's resistance) before any attacker-scoped penetration term.
step_3_scope_of_the_debuff_the_decisive_.consequence: Every damage source hitting that target while stacks are live — including allied champions who own no Black Cleaver — is mitigated by the reduced armor. Nothing in items.json, the atom taxonomy, or math-foundations.md conditions Carve on the identity of the damage source. Therefore, for a roster scenario in which one member carries Black Cleaver, an allied (support) physical-damage event that occurs while Carve stacks are live MUST carry a non-zero armor_reduction_percent contribution.
step_3_scope_of_the_debuff_the_decisive_.verdict_math: Deleting the entry sets the support-side Carve contribution to fraction 0.00 / factor 1.00. That is not an approximation of 2 stacks (0.12) nor of any other live stack count — it is the categorical absence of a debuff the item text guarantees, and it understates the support's physical damage by the full ~7% factor at the scenario's target armor.

residual_uncertainty.unresolvable_from_the_permitted_evidence: The oracle cannot see the scenario definition (it lives outside data/), so it cannot see (a) what occupies support_resistance_reduction[0], (b) whether combat event 23 is a physical- or magic-damage event, or (c) the fight timeline that fixes the true live stack count at that moment.
conditions_that_would_flip_the_verdict: If index [0] is ALSO a 'Black Cleaver — Carve' armor_reduction_percent entry, then the list was double-counting a single unique target debuff (armor reduction from one Black Cleaver applies once, max 30%), and deleting the duplicate at [1] would be correct.
If event 23 is a magic-damage (or true-damage) event, an armor_reduction_percent row is inert there and its removal is cosmetic.
residual_uncertainty.why_the_verdict_still_stands: Both flip conditions require facts not present in data/ or docs/math-foundations.md, whereas the source-backed rule (target-side shred benefits all damage sources) is explicit. Judged on the permitted evidence alone, a live Carve shred visible to the roster's support is correct and its complete absence is not.
residual_uncertainty.note_on_the_exact_stack_count: 2 stacks (0.12) at event index 23 is on the low side: a Black Cleaver holder applying one stack per physical-damage instance reaches the 5-stack cap within ~5 instances and the 6 s duration refreshes on every instance, so a team-wide shared debuff late in a fight would plausibly sit nearer 24-30%. That makes 0.12 a plausibly conservative value inside the documented APPROX class (§2.3), not a demonstrable error — hence 'old_value_correct' rather than 'both_wrong'.

verdict_summary: Black Cleaver's Carve is a 6%-per-stack (max 5 stacks / 30%, 6 s) reduction of the TARGET's armor, so an allied support's physical damage against that target is mitigated by the reduced armor. The removed entry's numbers are internally consistent (0.12 = 2 x 6%; factor 1.07 = (100+A)/(100+0.88A) for A ~ 104-139), and its magnitude sits inside the documented BC stack-average approximation class. Deleting it drops the support-visible shred to zero, which contradicts the cached item text. Caveat: if support_resistance_reduction[0] is a second Carve row for the same unique item, the deletion would instead be a correct de-duplication — that fact is not visible from data/ or docs/math-foundations.md.
